questions.poem_title: No Men are Foreign - James Falconer Kirkup
questions.question_en:
18. What is the figure of speech employed in the following line?
“Our hells of fire and dust outrage the innocence”.

questions.poem_title: No Men are Foreign - James Falconer Kirkup
questions.question_en:
98. Remember, no men are strange, no countries foreign
Beneath all uniforms, a single body breathes
...	...	...	...	...	...	...	...
Of air that is everywhere our own,
Remember, no men are foreign, no countries strange.
What literary device is used here?
